text:
Iris (PM): Quick thread to finalize the intake + scoring flow for the next design-partner cohort. Need a compact form and clear gates so we don't overcommit.

Noah (GTM): Suggest a 6-field scorecard (0-3): impact, readiness, compliance sensitivity, ops risk, engagement bandwidth, revenue potential. Auto-sort and shortlist top 8.

Vik (Eng): Capacity: we can host 6 private stacks concurrently; reserve 1 sandbox. Add an ops-risk flag for on-prem installs; flagged orgs require sandbox dry-run or extra SE hours.

Sana (CS): Incentive: $3k credit + optional case-study. Require a named tech lead + business sponsor. Ask for a 2-min workflow screen video to reduce back-and-forth.

June (Legal): Telemetry consent: aggregated metrics default, sampled outputs opt-in, customer-hosted logs via S3/KMS opt-in. Retention default 30 days; >30 requires AD. Add a short checkbox.

Iris (PM): Gating checklist before SE intro: 1) short form + video, 2) baseline eval run, 3) chosen telemetry profile + consent, 4) named contacts, 5) SLA acknowledgement.

Noah (GTM): Outreach snippet: "Join a limited design-partner cohort: dedicated onboarding, tuning, and $3k credit. Quick 5-min form + 2-min video. Interested?"

Vik (Eng): Baseline eval CLI (gating): `redwood-eval --suite dp-gate --routes routes.json --out gate.json`. Gate pass = p95 <= 3x target or agree to sandbox.

Sana (CS): Feedback cadence: twice-weekly 30m sessions weeks 0-2, then weekly 60m + office hours. Weekly 5-question quickform for blockers and asks. We'll produce a weekly signal pack (perf snapshot, regressions, open items).

Iris (PM): Success criteria: >=4 orgs reach "active" within 10 days, median p95 meets SLO for 80% of routes, at least 3 reproducible ask tickets, cohort satisfaction >=6/10 at week 4.

June (Legal): Add a short clause: Redwood will not use sampled outputs to train public models without explicit opt-in.

Iris (PM): Action items: Noah: outreach + form by EOD; Vik: gate CLI + sandbox plan by Thu; Sana: quickform + onboarding checklist by Thu; June: consent text + AD template by Thu. pilot-bot: reminder set for 2410000100 (ping #product).

Noah (GTM): Will post draft outreach soon.

Iris (PM): Thanks team :thumbsup:
